thread:
maria: Hey team — noticed a bunch of SCIM bulk jobs failing after we rolled the new SAML certs. Errors look like assertion size/parse failures. Anyone seen this?

dan: Can you paste the exact error? SCIM failures could be unrelated but related timing is suspicious.

maria: Paste from SCIM job logs: 

```
Error: failed to parse SAMLResponse: assertion truncated at 4096 bytes
at saml/decoder.go:142
caused_by: xml: unexpected EOF
```

samir: Huh — IdP usually signs and returns full Assertion. We recently enabled a new proxy (edge-lb) for compression. Could be header truncation or body size limit.

maria: We tested a single user create and that worked. Bulk was failing in 2k-5k user batches.

idp-bot: BulkProvisionJob 8274 status=failed error="Assertion too large" retries=2

dan: @samir can you check the nginx proxy buffers on the new edge-lb and any client_max_body_size / proxy_buffer_size changes in the template? If assertion is base64 XML in form POST, it can be large.

samir: Checking configs now. I see we set `proxy_buffer_size 4k` in the template for performance. That might chop the POST body when buffering. Also `client_max_body_size` was left at default 1m — should be fine but proxy_buffer_size is suspect.

maria: We also saw a few entries where IdP truncated attributes list (roles, groups) in the assertion. The assertion size grows with group memberships.

dan: Quick mitigation: reduce SCIM bulk batch size to 500 and add retry/backoff on partial failures. Also I'll push a hotfix to edge-lb template to bump `proxy_buffer_size 16k` and `proxy_busy_buffers_size` accordingly.

samir: Will push change and restart edge-lb pool in canary. Leaving one old node to compare logs.

maria: Thanks. For audit, can we tag affected jobs and capture the assertion payloads (sanitized) for triage? We need to know if any attributes were lost.

ops-oncall: On it — enabling extra logging for provisioning route. Capturing request body up to 64k, scrub email/PII before storing. ETA 20m.

dan: Also file a quick postmortem note once we confirm fix. Root cause likely proxy buffer + large group attribute sets causing base64 assertion to be truncated. Might want to add an SAML assertion size check in our validation layer and surface a clearer error (current xml EOF is noisy).

maria: Agreed. Adding validation issue to backlog and will create a short runbook for emergency: steps to reduce batch size, bump buffer, and where to find assertion logs.

samir: Canary looks good — one node got the larger assertions and processed them fine. I'll roll to the rest in 10m.

idp-bot: System: edge-lb pool update started by samir at 2921003500.

maria: Nice, keep me posted. If we confirm no attribute loss, we'll close the incident. :thumbsup:
